title: docs(ui): a component file and its helper never differ only by letter case
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8E7nn7vpAyMKtKMup2XHy9u)_
Part of #36753 — card item 4, the last code-side item. The card stays open after this merges: its macOS acceptance items 1–2 need a person on a Mac, and the seat moves the card to a maintainer check.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；界面代码的编写规则里多了一条：组件文件和它的辅助文件不能只靠首字母大小写区分。
- 为什么做：属于「运行界面的设计模式」专题，是 Mac 上控制台打包失败那张卡的最后一项；改名和自动检查已在上一个合并里落地，这一条让写代码的人和 AI 事先知道规则。
- 出错会怎样：只加一行规则文字，不改任何代码；撤回这一个合并即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：这是受管文件，需要 os-zhuang 批准后才能合并；合并后卡片不自动关闭，留给有 Mac 的人验收打包和三个页面。

## What changes

One line in `ui/AGENTS.md` § 5 Coding Standards, after #13 — card item 4:

> **#14 — A component file and its helper never differ only by letter case.** `Foo.tsx` beside `foo.ts` is ONE module on a case-insensitive file system (macOS, Windows): `./Foo.js` resolves to the helper, so the type build and the console bundle break there while Linux CI stays green. Give the helper a suffix (`fooModel.ts`). At the repository root, `pnpm check:gitlink-declared` runs `scripts/check-case-colliding-paths.mjs`, which refuses any two entries in one directory whose names, with the last extension dropped, differ only by case.

Per that file's #9, the rule points at the instrument that re-derives it (the gate landed in the previous PR for this card) and writes down no count. It cites no tracker number.

Governed surface: `ui/AGENTS.md` is Tier H. This PR stays a draft for the seat's contract review and the maintainer's approval.

## Tests

<details><summary>Derived gates for this diff, all exit 0 at head fd1db479</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 16 commands for this diff; each ran locally, exit 0 (the full set on the first head's tree, which differs from `fd1db479` by four words in this one line): `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (+ `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:published-files`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:registry-log-declared`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.

At `fd1db479` (the contract review's round-1 fix: the line now says the command and the script are at the repository root, since `ui/AGENTS.md` reads paths relative to `ui/`), the gates that read the file's text re-ran, exit 0: `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1–2 (a clean console build on macOS, and the record page, 「编辑应用」 into design mode and 「配置页签」 opening in that build) need a human on a Mac; NOT MEASURED in this Linux container. The renames that fix it merged in the previous PR for this card; its CI (Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Test UI) was green on Linux.
- Card acceptance 3 (a planted `Foo.tsx` + `foo.ts` reds on Linux) and 4 (the PR lists the renames, the scan and where the check runs) were measured and recorded on the previous PR.
- `skip-changeset`: `ui/AGENTS.md` is in no published package's `files[]` (the `ui/` workspace root is private).

## Verification

Read the one added line in `ui/AGENTS.md` § 5 and run `pnpm check:gitlink-declared`: it prints `check-case-colliding-paths: OK (… 0 case-colliding group(s))`.
